# Bhikkhu Vibhaṅga Pācittiya 8 (Bu-Vb Pc8)

**ID:** Bu-Vb Pc8
**Section:** Bhikkhu Vibhaṅga (bu-vb)
**Collection:** Vinaya
**Title (Pali):** Bhikkhu Vibhaṅga Pācittiya 8
**Title (English, from literature):** Truthfully announcing a superhuman quality
**tipitaka.org (CST):** https://tipitaka.org/romn/cscd/vin02m1.mul0.xml

## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

The *Bhūtārocana Sikkhāpada* ("Truthfully announcing a superhuman quality"), cataloged as Bhikkhu Vibhaṅga Pācittiya 8 (Vin IV 25), establishes that a Buddhist monk commits a *pācittiya* offense if he announces an actual, true superhuman spiritual attainment (*uttarimanussadhamma*) or enlightenment to an unordained person, such as a layperson [Gombrich 1996]. Whereas falsely claiming spiritual attainments incurs the grave penalty of expulsion under *Pārājika* 4, truthful disclosure to the unordained remains an offense requiring confession under this rule [Gombrich 1996]. An English translation of the rule and its accompanying vibhaṅga has been made by Bhikkhu Brahmali.

 DharmaNexus also indicates internal reuse with the *Pavāraṇākkhandhaka* (Kd 4), preceding Pācittiya rules (Pc 1–3), and canonical Abhidhamma and Khuddaka texts, along with automated alignments to the Tibetan *Vinayavastu* (D0001) and *Vinayapraśnaṭīkā* (D4135) [DharmaNexus].
